title: Packaged recorder and media stress evidence
minimumPromotionPolicy: Packaged recorder promotion requires positive packaged start/stop evidence with visible microphone foreground disclosure, deterministic stop behavior, task removal cleanup, relaunch/crash recovery, quota enforcement, temporary output cleanup, missing capability denial, missing Android permission denial, and rollback behavior.

stressMatrix.requiredEvidence: Packaged project resolves media, mediainfo, and recorder modules, returns recorder status, denies start, and rejects missing media.audio/media.metadata/media.recording capabilities.
Packaged APK starts a microphone recorder session, surfaces visible foreground disclosure, returns JSON-safe session/status, stops deterministically, and closes owned resources.
Task removal, app relaunch, process death, provider crash, and Safe downgrade stop owned sessions and clean temporary outputs without leaking microphone capture.
Quota limits, scoped temporary output paths, delete-on-stop, delete-on-destroy, failure cleanup, and rollback cleanup are deterministic.
Missing capability, missing Android RECORD_AUDIO permission, denied runtime prompt, missing foreground-service microphone metadata, and Safe downgrade denials remain stable.

requiredArchives.requiredEvidence: Packaged recorder positive start/stop archive with visible microphone foreground disclosure, stop action, JSON-safe session/status, and owned resource cleanup.
Packaged recorder task removal, relaunch, and provider/process crash archive proving deterministic stop and temporary output cleanup.
Packaged recorder quota and scoped temporary output archive proving no raw file descriptor, no broad media-library permission, and cleanup on stop/destroy/failure/rollback.
Packaged recorder denial archive for missing media.recording, missing Android permission, denied prompt, and metadata mismatch before bridge dispatch.
Packaged recorder microphone foreground disclosure and stop-action archive proving user-visible ownership and deterministic stop behavior.
